title: Plausible Is Not Proven: Testing Failure Explanations in Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Failure analyses of monocular depth models often name a cause for each error, such as an occluding boundary, a thin object or a reflective surface, but such labels are rarely tested. We present the Vision Error Observatory (VEO), an audit that finds regions failing the $\delta_1$ criterion on sensor-measured pixels, labels each with a likely cause or abstains, and then subjects the labels to four tests: agreement with object annotations on data the label model never saw, agreement with blinded human raters, response to targeted image edits, and value as a training signal. We apply it to eight models on NYU Depth V2, DIODE and iBims-1, with labels also checked on Hypersim, and fix most decision rules before their results. translated_title: 合理不等于证实：测试单目深度估计中的失败解释
translated_abstract: 单目深度模型的失败分析通常会为每个错误指认一个原因，例如遮挡边界、细小物体或反射表面，但这类标签很少经过实际检验。我们提出了视觉误差观测台（Vision Error Observatory, VEO），这是一种审计方法，它在传感器测量像素上找出未通过 δ1 准则的区域，为每个区域标注一个可能的原因或选择弃权，然后对标签施加四项检验：与标签模型从未见过的数据上物体标注的一致性、与盲测人类评分者的一致性、对针对性图像编辑的响应，以及作为训练信号的价值。我们将其应用于 NYU Depth V2、DIODE 和 iBims-1 数据集上的八个模型，并在 Hypersim 上对标签进行额外检验，且大多数决策规则在看到结果之前就已固定。遮挡边界标签与物体标注一致（NYU 上 AUROC 为 0.85，Hypersim 上为 0.81，iBims-1 上为 0.69），但单一的深度边缘线索也能达到同样效果，并且最强模型的大多数边界失败在 2-
tldr: 提出视觉误差观测台（VEO）审计框架，通过四项独立检验来验证单目深度估计失败原因标签的可信度，发现遮挡边界标签虽有解释力但并不优于简单的深度边缘线索。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Vision Error Observatory (VEO), an audit framework that validates failure explanation labels in monocular depth estimation through four independent tests, revealing that occluding-boundary labels, while consistent with annotations, perform no better than a simple depth-edge cue.
